text:
mira: deploy-bot flagged an unusual traffic redistribution after the 5% canary bump for inference v7.0.1. Change window ends in ~50m — requesting stop/go call.

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary 5% -> error rate +0.6% (baseline 0.12%), p95 latency +95ms, routing-redispatch rate +2.4% (baseline 0.1%). Event ref: rd-11a. No auto-rollback rule matched. See /deploy 55432 for diffs and routing config.

dan: can we see the redispatch trace? which layer is causing reroute?

mira: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/canary/55432/traces 5% of redispatches show downstream 502 from knative-proxy when the instance selector misses. Looks like new instance labels from v7 didn't match the selector in the region.

sylvia: ack. If selector mismatch is causing reroutes we could see transient connection failures -> user errors. I'd vote pin+hold.

infra: quick note: we pushed a node-label normalization change in kube-ops last night that may affect new deployments. Might be the root cause.

sam: vote: hold progression to 10% and pin to v6.9.0-stable until we validate label mapping. Pin prevents further percent increases but keeps current canary traffic at 5%.

mira: running: `rollout pin --deployment inference-canary --version v6.9.0-stable --by mira --reason "redispatch due to label selector mismatch"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout pinned to v6.9.0-stable by mira at 7900000098. Canary traffic frozen at 5%.

qa: I'll run a targeted smoke suite against the pinned path and exercise routing selectors. ETA ~12m.

dan: infra, can you confirm the node-label normalization diff and whether it's opt-in? If it's unintentional we'll revert.

infra: that change was intended but behind a feature flag; looks like v7 agent picked up the new label set via bootstrap. We'll roll a quick flag rollback in the canary pool and re-run. ETA 8m.

product: update release notes: add an entry under "Deployment and routing" about the label mismatch, and state rollback criteria: redispatch >1% sustained for 15m OR error rate >0.3% sustained for 15m -> full rollback.

deploy-bot: [update] feature-flag rollback started at 7900000110 on canary pool. Re-routing smoke tests queued.

infra: feature flag rollback applied. Preliminary trace shows redispatches down 70% on affected hosts.

qa: smoke run: 95% green, redispatch now 0.18%, error rate 0.14%, p95 +40ms.

sylvia: that's within our resume criteria but I'd like a 20m observation window before unpin. Request manual consensus.

dan: agree. Vote below: :+1: wait 20m, :eyes: unpin now and proceed, :-1: rollback fully.

mira: :+1:

infra: :+1:

qa: :+1:

product: :eyes: (lean wait)

deploy-bot: [action] Monitoring window extended 20m. If redispatch stays <0.2% and error <0.2% for rolling 20m, we can unpin and continue a conservative bump to 8% with manual step.

mira: will draft the postmortem skeleton and link telemetry when window closes. Thanks team.
